summary: VivoSim Labs filed a Form 8-K announcing its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders scheduled for September 30, 2026, with a record date of August 13, 2026. Because the meeting date advanced by more than 30 days from the prior annual meeting anniversary, the company provided deadlines for stockholder proposals and director nominations, requiring written notice by August 9, 2026. This is a routine administrative notice regarding meeting logistics and advance notice procedures, not a special-situation event.
